title: The frontal lobes enable access, not experience itself

statements.text: IWMT agrees with GNWT that the frontal lobes are likely required to access experiences, that is to manipulate, reflect on and report their contents. IIT and GNWT are both right about the substrate, but for basic phenomenal and access consciousness respectively.

sources.quote: IWMT also agrees with GNWT that the frontal lobes are likely required for accessing such experiences in terms of being able to manipulate, reflect, and report on their contents
IWMT considers both positions to be accurate, but with respect to basic phenomenal and access consciousness, respectively.
